mapper.sql: select u.user_id, u.dept_id, u.user_name, u.nick_name,u.sync_user_id,u.maindepartment,u.user_type, u.email, u.avatar, u.phonenumber, u.password, u.sex, u.status, u.del_flag, u.login_ip, u.login_date, u.create_by, u.create_time, u.remark,u.id_Card_No, d.dept_id, d.parent_id, d.dept_name, d.order_num, d.leader, d.status as dept_status, r.role_id, r.role_name, r.role_key, r.role_sort, r.data_scope, r.status as role_status ,uf.COMPANY,uf.COMPANYID, uf.EMPLOYEE,uf.DEPARTMENT, uf.DEPARTMENTID, uf.BRANCH,uf.BRANCHID,uf.USERGROUP, uf.USERGROUPID,uf.HALL, uf.HALLID, uf.TELEPHONE, uf.EMAIL, uf.title as TITLE, uf.USERPOSILEVEL, uf.EMPLOYEECLASS from sys_user u left join sys_dept d on u.dept_id = d.dept_id left join sys_user_role ur on u.user_id = ur.user_id left join sys_role r on r.role_id = ur.role_id left join uum_userinfo uf on uf.USERID=u.user_name
mapper.select: select count(1) from sys_user where user_name = #{userName} limit 1
select count(1) from sys_user where sync_user_id = #{syncUserId} limit 1
select user_id, phonenumber from sys_user where phonenumber = #{phonenumber} limit 1
select user_id, email from sys_user where email = #{email} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into sys_user( user_id, dept_id, user_name, nick_name, sync_user_id, maindepartment, user_type, email, avatar, phonenumber, sex, password, status, create_by, remark, id_Card_No, create_time )values( #{userId}, #{deptId}, #{userName}, #{nickName}, #{syncUserId}, #{maindepartment}, #{userType}, #{email}, #{avatar}, #{phonenumber}, #{sex}, #{password}, #{status}, #{createBy}, #{remark}, #{idCardNo}, sysdate() )
mapper.update: update sys_user set status = #{status} where user_id = #{userId}

mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id AS userId,u.user_name AS userName,u.nick_name AS nickName,d.dept_name AS depName,p.post_id AS postId,p.post_name AS postName FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN sys_dept d on u.dept_id = d.dept_id LEFT JOIN sys_user_post sup on sup.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_post p on p.post_id = sup.post_id where u.user_id IN( SELECT user_id FROM sys_user_post up where up.post_id IN( SELECT sp.user_id from sys_user_post sp where sp.post_id = (SELECT p.post_id FROM sys_post p where p.post_name = #{postName}) ) )and u.dept_id = #{deptId}
SELECT u.* FROM sys_user u left join sys_user_role r on u.user_id =r.user_id left join sys_role s on s.role_id = r.role_id where s.role_key =#{roleKey}

SELECT u.user_id, u.dept_id, u.nick_name, u.user_name, u.email, u.avatar, u.phonenumber, u.password, u.sex, u.status, u.del_flag, u.login_ip, u.login_date, u.create_by, u.create_time, u.remark, d.dept_name AS dept_name, d.leader, u.`user_id`, u.`user_id` AS erpid FROM sys_user u JOIN sys_dept d ON u.dept_id = d.dept_id
AND (u.user_name like concat('%', #{userName}, '%') or u.nick_name like concat('%', #{userName}, '%'))
AND u.status = #{status}
AND date_format(u.create_time,'%y%m%d') >= date_format(#{beginTime},'%y%m%d')
AND date_format(u.create_time,'%y%m%d') <= date_format(#{endTime},'%y%m%d')
AND u.user_id IN(SELECT user_id FROM sys_user_role WHERE role_id = #{roleId})
